author: Jonathan_M

title: Great experience with a passionate guide
text: The Alhambra is by itself a wonderful place but Emilio made it even greater. He is obviously very passionate and knowledgeable and conveys his love for the Alhambra and Granada in an entertaining way.  We learnt lots of things on the visit! He also recommended places to visit and where to eat in the city. Emilio also spoke very good English with a great sense of humour.  We would definitely recommend a tour with Enjoy Alhambra.
author: Ambassador235003

title: Excellent tour with Emilio!
text: We did the full Alhambra tour with our guide Emilio. He is an excellent guide. The truth is that I didn't realize we had spent 3 hours. He explained the history of the Alhambra and then gave us a lot of information about how people lived in the Alhambra during the various periods of its existence. He explained things and asked us questions, so the experience was very interactive and informative. It was a pleasure to spend the morning with him and learn so much about this historic and impressive monument.
author: Shabbab_K

title: Alhambra with the perfect guide - Emilio
text: Excellent guide, demonstrated immense knowledge of history, super available and always ready to answer all questions. Without a doubt the best, I can only recommend. Thank you very much Emílio.
